data.title: 牧之原翔子 · 厨房里系好的围裙
data.description: 【梓川家厨房·清晨】翔子把长发束成侧辫，穿着素雅围裙准备便当，先把每一块水果摆成整齐的小花，再把写好祝福的便签压在盒盖下。
data.action: 准备便当把水果摆成小花，将祝福便签压在盒盖下
data.lighting: soft morning light over a clean counter
data.mood: 把照料写进每一个便当细节
data.promptProse: Shouko Makinohara from Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai wears a cream blouse, long blue skirt and plain cotton apron, with her hair gathered into a braid. She ties her side braid before arranging fruit into a small flower inside the lunch box. She presses a handwritten blessing beneath the lid and looks toward the viewer with a calm smile, making the quiet kitchen feel like a promise carried through the day. soft morning light over a clean counter.
